name: ZSP_BR_ATTRIBUTES_B
description: This table is to store the attributes of an entity.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: the primary key

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: a language independent name for the attribute that corresponds to the attribute name in the view object

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator that shows if the attribute is active.

columns.name: LIST_FLAG
columns.description: 1 iff the attribute is a list

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: one of 'Entity', 'Boolean', 'Byte', 'Short', 'Integer', 'Long', 'Float', 'Double', 'String', 'BigDecimal', 'Date', 'Time', or 'Timestamp'

columns.name: PART_OF_PRIMARY_KEY_FLAG
columns.description: 1 iff the attribute is part of the primary key for the entity

columns.name: REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: 1 iff the attribute is required

columns.name: ORDERABLE_FLAG
columns.description: 1 iff the values are orderable

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: the id of the entity that this attribute belongs to

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_POSITION
columns.description: the 0-based position of the attribute within the entity

columns.name: LOV_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: the id of the LOV that is applicable to this attribute, if any

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY
columns.description: Resource key from extensibility resource bundle.

columns.name: RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: Resource Bundle Id from extensibility resource bundle.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
